story.iWant: to discover and document components from shadcn registries that best fit the app's analytics dashboard needs
story.soThat: we can leverage existing, well-designed components and maintain a comprehensive component library documentation using Storybook
story.tasks:
- [ ] Task 1: Research component discovery tools and best practices (AC: #1, #5) - [ ] Research shadcn MCP capabilities for component discovery - [ ] Research Storybook setup and configuration for Next.js - [ ] Research context7 MCP for accessing library documentation - [ ] Use web search to find component discovery best practices - [ ] Document discovery methodology and tools
- [ ] Task 2: Discover components from shadcn registries (AC: #1, #2) - [ ] Use shadcn MCP to list available registries - [ ] Search @shadcn registry for analytics/dashboard components - [ ] Search @magicui registry for chart/metric components - [ ] Search @aceternity registry for interactive/visualization components - [ ] Search @shadcnblocks registry for dashboard layout components - [ ] Document discovered components with registry sources
- [ ] Task 3: Evaluate discovered components (AC: #2) - [ ] Evaluate alignment with design system (tailwind-variants, design guide) - [ ] Assess suitability for analytics dashboard use cases - [ ] Check TypeScript support and type safety - [ ] Verify accessibility compliance - [ ] Review component quality and documentation - [ ] Create evaluation matrix with recommendations
- [ ] Task 4: Set up Storybook for component documentation (AC: #3) - [ ] Install Storybook dependencies (`@storybook/nextjs`, `@storybook/react`, etc.) - [ ] Initialize Storybook configuration (`.storybook/main.ts`, `.storybook/preview.ts`) - [ ] Configure TypeScript with path aliases (@/components, @/lib) - [ ] Configure Next.js App Router support in Storybook - [ ] Set up theme decorator for light/dark mode - [ ] Test Storybook builds and runs correctly
- [ ] Task 5: Create Storybook stories for existing components (AC: #3) - [ ] Create stories for Card component (all variants: metric, chart, info, role) - [ ] Create stories for Badge component (all variants) - [ ] Create stories for Button component (all variants) - [ ] Create stories for Alert component (all variants) - [ ] Create stories for other key UI components - [ ] Add component documentation (JSDoc, usage examples, props tables)
- [ ] Task 6: Document discovered components and recommendations (AC: #4) - [ ] Create component discovery report document - [ ] Document registry sources for each discovered component - [ ] Include evaluation results and recommendations - [ ] Provide usage examples for recommended components - [ ] Create integration guide for adding components to project - [ ] Update component inventory documentation
- [ ] Task 7: Create Storybook stories for recommended components (AC: #4) - [ ] Select top 3-5 recommended components to demonstrate - [ ] Add recommended components to project (if feasible for demo) - [ ] Create Storybook stories showing component variations - [ ] Document integration process and any modifications needed - [ ] Add usage examples and best practices
- [ ] Task 8: Finalize documentation and update project docs (AC: #5) - [ ] Document context7 MCP usage for library documentation - [ ] Document shadcn MCP usage for component discovery - [ ] Update README with Storybook documentation links - [ ] Create component library documentation guide - [ ] Test: Verify Storybook builds and all stories render correctly - [ ] Test: Verify component discovery report is complete

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. **Given** the project uses shadcn/UI components and has multiple registries configured (@shadcn, @magicui, @aceternity, @shadcnblocks) **When** I search for analytics, dashboard, chart, metric, and statistics components **Then** the system discovers relevant components from registries: - Components for data visualization (charts, graphs, metrics) - Analytics dashboard components (statistics cards, KPI displays) - Interactive components (filters, date pickers, search) - Layout components (dashboards, grids, responsive layouts) - Components that align with app design needs (modern, beautiful, analytics-focused)
2. **And** discovered components are evaluated against: - Alignment with app design system (tailwind-variants, design guide specifications) - Suitability for analytics dashboard use cases - TypeScript support and type safety - Accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA) - Component quality and documentation
3. **And** Storybook is set up and configured for component documentation: - Storybook installation and configuration for Next.js with App Router - TypeScript configuration with path aliases (@/components) - Story files created for key existing components (Card, Badge, Button, etc.) - Storybook preview configured with theme support (light/dark mode) - Documentation structure established for component library
4. **And** discovered components are documented: - Component discovery report with registry sources and evaluation results - Recommendations for which components to add to the project - Storybook stories created for newly discovered/recommended components - Usage examples and integration notes for recommended components - Component inventory updated with discovered options
5. **And** documentation includes: - Usage of context7 MCP for library documentation (Storybook, shadcn, etc.) - Usage of shadcn MCP for component discovery - Web search research for component discovery best practices - Integration guide for adding recommended components to the project

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: ShadCN/UI copy-paste model - components are in src/components/ui/ directory. Styling uses Tailwind CSS 3.3.0 with utility-first approach, using tailwind-variants for variant system. Type safety maintained with TypeScript 5.0.0 strict mode.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Tailwind CSS 3.3.0 - Utility-first CSS framework. Custom color theme (Competitive Data). Responsive breakpoints. Dark theme support. Uses tailwind-variants for variant system instead of class-variance-authority.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Components located in src/components/ui/ following shadcn/UI copy-paste model. Storybook configuration should be in .storybook/ directory at project root. Story files co-located with components in src/components/ui/*.stories.tsx or in .storybook/stories/.

doc.title: Story 3.1: Migrate Components to Tailwind Variants
doc.snippet: Component patterns established from ShadCN/UI. Migration from class-variance-authority to tailwind-variants for better type safety and composition. All components maintain backward compatibility with same APIs. All components use tv() function and VariantProps from tailwind-variants.

doc.title: Story 3.2: Enhance Card Component Variants
doc.snippet: Card component now has enhanced variants (metric, chart, info, role) with comprehensive JSDoc documentation. Component tests established at tests/components/ui-components.test.tsx with 32 tests. All Card variants match design guide specifications.

doc.title: Story 3.3: Apply Card Variants to Dashboard
doc.snippet: All Card variants match design guide specifications (metric: 8px radius/20px padding, role: 12px radius/24px padding). Components located in src/components/ui/ following shadcn/UI copy-paste model. All components use tailwind-variants with tv() function for variant composition.

doc.title: ShadCN/UI Configuration
doc.snippet: Multiple registries configured: @shadcn, @magicui, @aceternity, @shadcnblocks, @blocks, @reui, @smoothui, @shadcn-studio, @tailark. Style: new-york. RSC: true. TypeScript: true. Path aliases: @/components, @/lib/utils.

doc.title: Sprint Status
doc.snippet: Epic 3: Design System Enhancement (2025-01-27). Sprint Change: UI/UX Design System Enhancement via correct-course workflow. All stories complete - design system migrated to tailwind-variants with enhanced Card variants. Story 3-4 is currently in drafted status.

artifact.reason: Enhanced Card component with variants (metric, chart, info, role) using tailwind-variants. Reference implementation for variant patterns. Comprehensive JSDoc documentation included.
Button component migrated to tailwind-variants. Uses tv() function and VariantProps. Reference for migration pattern and variant structure.
Badge component migrated to tailwind-variants. Uses tv() for variant definitions. Reference for migration pattern.
Alert component migrated to tailwind-variants. Shows variant pattern with default and destructive variants. Reference for component structure.
ShadCN/UI configuration file with registry definitions. Contains all configured registries (@shadcn, @magicui, @aceternity, etc.) and path aliases. Required for shadcn MCP component discovery.

Directory containing all UI components. Components include: alert, avatar, badge, button, card, checkbox, dialog, form, input, label, navigation-menu, select, sheet, table, tabs, toast, and more. All components use tailwind-variants pattern.

Package dependencies including React 19.2.0, Next.js 16.0.0, TypeScript 5.0.0, tailwind-variants 3.2.2, and Radix UI components. Storybook dependencies need to be added: @storybook/nextjs, @storybook/react, etc.
TypeScript configuration with path aliases (@/* → ./src/*). Required for Storybook to resolve component imports correctly.

constraint.description: ShadCN/UI copy-paste model - components must be in src/components/ui/ directory. Components are copied into project, not installed as npm packages.
All components must use tailwind-variants with tv() function for variant composition. Do not use class-variance-authority. Maintain backward compatibility with existing component APIs.
TypeScript 5.0.0 with strict mode. All Storybook stories must have proper TypeScript types. Component props must be typed using VariantProps from tailwind-variants.

Components must align with design guide specifications. Follow established variant patterns (metric: 8px radius/20px padding, role: 12px radius/24px padding). Use design tokens from UX Design Specification.
All discovered components must meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Components should use Radix UI primitives for accessibility. Verify keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and color contrast ratios.
Storybook must support Next.js App Router structure with route groups. Configure Storybook to handle App Router patterns and server components appropriately.
Use path aliases (@/components, @/lib) consistently. Storybook configuration must resolve these aliases correctly. TypeScript path mapping must be configured in Storybook.
Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Storybook stories serve as visual regression tests and documentation. Component tests located in tests/components/ directory.

interface.name: shadcn MCP
interface.signature: get_project_registries(), list_items_in_registries(registries), search_items_in_registries(registries, query), view_items_in_registries(items), get_item_examples_from_registries(registries, query)
interface.description: MCP server for discovering and viewing components from shadcn registries. Use to search for analytics, dashboard, chart, metric components across configured registries.

interface.name: context7 MCP
interface.description: MCP server for accessing up-to-date documentation for libraries. Use to get Storybook documentation, shadcn documentation, and other library docs.

interface.name: Card Component API
interface.signature: Card({ variant, roleType, className, children, ...props }: CardProps)
interface.description: Card component with variants: default, elevated, outlined, ghost, interactive, metric, chart, info, role. Uses tailwind-variants for variant composition. Reference implementation for component patterns.

tests.standards: Test coverage minimum 80% for all new code. Component tests use Vitest with React Testing Library. Storybook stories serve as visual regression tests and documentation. E2E tests use Playwright. Component tests located in tests/components/ directory. All Storybook stories should have proper TypeScript types. Accessibility testing via @axe-core/playwright for E2E tests. Component tests verify variant rendering, prop handling, and accessibility compliance.
